hero.h1: Plumbing Maintenance and Inspections in Algonquin, IL
hero.sub: If your home was built in the 1990s or 2000s, the equipment that came with it is reaching the end. A maintenance visit tells you what's close to failing so you can replace it on your schedule. From our office on Esplanade Drive.

blocks.h2: What an Algonquin Plumbing Checkup Covers
blocks.intro: Everything that came with the house:

steps.body: Age, leaks, relief valve, venting and sediment, with a flush if it's due.
A full test cycle before the river rises.
Salt, settings and whether it's actually softening.
Slow drains or gurgling get a [camera inspection](/algonquin/video-camera-sewer-inspections).
Original braided lines, washer hoses and valves.
Fine, plan for it or fix it now.

blocks.intro: With a median home built in 1994, Algonquin is in the replacement years.

items.body: In homes built in the 1990s and 2000s, water heaters, sump pumps, softeners and supply lines installed with the house are now 17 to 36 years old.
Subdivision trees are big enough to reach sewer lines. A camera look catches it early.
A spring visit tests the sump pump and backup before the Fox River rises.
When the softener isn't keeping up, scale builds in the water heater. We check both on the same visit.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: Is a checkup worth it for a house that's only 25 years old?
items.preview: Yes. That's when original equipment starts failing.
items.answer: Yes. The pipes are likely fine, but the water heater, sump pump, softener and supply lines are at the age when they start to fail.
Spring works best, so we can test the sump pump and backup before heavy rain and high water.
Yes. We check salt, settings and regeneration and tell you if it needs service.
Yes. The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) brings a plumber to your home for regular maintenance.

items.q: Can you check my sprinkler backflow device?
items.preview: We can check its condition and shutoffs.
items.answer: We can check the backflow device and shutoffs for leaks and damage. Annual testing certification, where required, may be done by a certified tester.

items.q: What does a plumbing checkup cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on what's included. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on the size of the home and add-ons like a sewer camera inspection or water heater flush. We quote a flat rate before we start.
